Ben / Marissa — technical note for the matrix and runbook:

1) Region pinning: Dedicated tenant metadata and all active model KV caches are pinned to the provisioned region (US-West-2) and routed to a region-scoped GPU pool. We do not replicate active tenant data to other regions by default.

2) Backups & snapshots: Nightly snapshots are sharded per-tenant; each snapshot record includes region and storage bucket ID. Cross-region replication is opt-in and disabled unless explicitly configured by the customer. For Finova we'll disable replication in the account baseline.

3) Wipe & proof: Tenant erase triggers a coordinated workflow: a) mark for purge, b) delete live storage objects, c) scrub KV & caches, d) schedule snapshot tombstone & retention trigger, e) provide an audit package (delete logs, storage object manifests, snapshot tombstone IDs). Evidence package format: CSV manifest + signed hash list + timestamped logs. Typical delivery: 5–7 business days after request (shorter for emergency wipes).

4) Audit logs: API and cluster-level audit logs with tenant IDs (we’ll provide scoped extracts) plus object-level deletion receipts. Retention policy for audit logs is 90 days by default for Dedicated; extended retention can be negotiated.

5) Cryptographic controls: We can provide KMS key IDs and attest that keys are region-bound if Finova manages keys in a regional KMS; otherwise Redwood-managed KMS keys are used but keys are stored and used in-region.

I'll attach a short runbook and the proposed matrix to hand over to Marissa. Anything else you want to surface in the attestation template?

—Karthik
